tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The only background on the site.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, the wordmark, strong text and the button fill. On surface: 19.7:1.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text on surface: 8.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, the footer and link hover on surface: 5.8:1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Slash separators in the client list. Decoration only; never set text in it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines that open a section and separate rows. Decoration; sections are also set apart by space and headers.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill, as in buttons: 19.7:1.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Sticky nav background over scrolling content, used with blur-veil.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Centre of the soft contact shadow under the chrome form, fading to clear.

styles.name: display-wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the homepage hero. Desktop size; fluid as clamp(56px, 18vw, 260px).

styles.name: display-statement
styles.usage: Page titles and the closing line. Desktop size; fluid as clamp(40px, 8.4vw, 124px).

styles.name: heading-section
styles.usage: Section headers, in the left column. Desktop size; fluid as clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 52px).

styles.name: heading-item
styles.usage: Row titles such as service names. Desktop size; fluid as clamp(22px, 2.4vw, 34px).

styles.name: heading-claim
styles.sample: I build products end to end.
styles.usage: Short claim headings in a three-up grid. Desktop size; fluid as clamp(22px, 2vw, 28px).

styles.name: text-lead
styles.sample: Product engineering for the AI era.
styles.usage: The statement under a title. Desktop size; fluid as clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 34px).

styles.name: text-list
styles.usage: Large inline lists such as client names. Desktop size; fluid as clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 30px).

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Agents, automations, and LLM integrations that take manual work off a team.

styles.name: text-nav
styles.usage: Nav links and the nav pill. Desktop size; fluid as clamp(14px, 1.1vw, 15px).

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the page at desktop. Fluid as clamp(16px, 4.4vw, 64px).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Space below each section. Fluid as clamp(64px, 8vw, 120px).

tokens.name: space-section-top
tokens.usage: Space between a section's hairline and its content. Fluid as clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px).

tokens.name: space-col
tokens.usage: Gap between a section's header and its content, and between claim columns.

tokens.name: space-actions
tokens.usage: Gap between a button and the link beside it.

tokens.name: space-row
tokens.usage: Padding above and below each list row. Fluid as clamp(14px, 1.5vw, 20px).

tokens.name: space-stack
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and the paragraph under it.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons. Nothing else is rounded.

tokens.name: size-container
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page column.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of a button.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of nav links and the nav pill; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: blur-veil
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind the sticky nav.
